novel.title: The Perfect Run
novel.summary: Ryan Romano, alias Quicksave, is a Genome with the power to create save points and stop time. After years of lonely wandering in a post-apocalyptic Europe ravaged by the Genome Wars, he arrives in New Rome—a megacity controlled by corporations and crime syndicates—searching for his childhood best friend Len (Eleonora Sabino). Over countless loops, Ryan navigates the warring factions of the Augusti crime family, the Meta-Gang Psychos, the corporate heroes of Il Migliore, and the Carnival vigilantes, all while uncovering a conspiracy involving Mechron's doomsday bunker, a Bloodstream pandemic threat, and Dynamis' exploitation of Len's Genius. His quest culminates in engineering a 'Perfect Run'—a loop where Len's memories survive the reset via a brain-transfer device—finally breaking his centuries-long isolation.

characters.name: Ryan Romano
characters.age: appears mid-20s biologically; centuries old functionally due to loops
characters.description: Handsome young man with black hair. Wears a metal mouthless mask with two rounded glass eyes, a black top hat, navy blue trench coat, purple shirt, blue pants, black gloves, and boots. Later upgraded to a dark purple cashmere suit with a violet-pink scarf bearing clock symbols, a bowler hat, and skull-patterned socks. Adopts a presidential costume in later arcs.
characters.personality: Irreverently humorous, deeply empathetic beneath layers of sarcasm, driven by an overwhelming love for Len, prone to loneliness-induced recklessness. Fiercely protective of children. Genuinely enjoys chaos and style. Philosophically comfortable with uncertainty. Despite his jokes, carries immense hidden grief from centuries of isolation.
characters.background: Orphaned young. Grew up with Len under the care of Bloodstream (Freddie Sabino), a Psycho with blood manipulation powers. Was present when the Carnival hunted Bloodstream down, resulting in Len fleeing and their separation. Spent years wandering post-apocalyptic Europe as a courier, searching for Len. Gained his Elixir (Violet) at some point prior to the story, giving him the ability to stop time and create save points. Has lived through countless loops across centuries of subjective time.
characters.current_power_level: Violet Genome (Save Point / Time Stop); informally Genius-level through accumulated loop knowledge

power_progression.stage: Mastery of timestop precision and knife-throwing via loop training
Presidential armor with full Genius-level gadgetry

special_abilities: Quicksave: Creates a temporal save point at a chosen moment; upon death, reverts to that point with full memory
Time Stop: Freezes all observable time temporarily; duration scales with experience and Rampage enhancement
Enhanced Timing Sense: After experiencing a sequence once, can anticipate events with superhuman reaction
Autopilot Mode: Can replay memorized sequences of actions on autopilot while thinking of other things
Purple World perception: Partially perceives the Violet dimension during time-stop

characters.name: Eleonora Sabino
characters.description: Petite young woman with short black hair and bright blue eyes. Wears a large JIM-style diving armor she built herself, crimson-painted and rugged in design. In casual settings, appears pale and exhausted from depression and medication overuse.
characters.personality: Deeply empathetic, passionate about justice and protecting the weak, politically communist (Marxist-Leninist). Struggles with severe depression and social withdrawal without heavy medication. Brilliant engineer. Can be stubborn and self-sacrificing. Has difficulty trusting others due to traumatic upbringing under Bloodstream. Possesses a quietly warm love for Ryan that she finds difficult to express.
characters.background: Daughter of Freddie Sabino (Bloodstream). Ryan's childhood companion. Fled to New Rome after the Carnival hunted Bloodstream and began selling her Genius inventions as 'The Underdiver.' Was captured by Dynamis' Private Security after attacking a Dynamis chemical plant. Eventually lives in an undersea habitat she built near Ischia. Took her Elixir at some point, becoming a Genius with water-manipulation powers. Dynamis wanted her for her ability to refine Elixir processing.
special_abilities: Hydrokinesis: Control and manipulation of water with extreme precision; can form water prisons, projectiles, and shields
Genius-level intellect: Specializes in submarine engineering, materials science, Elixir refinement, and brain-computer interfaces
Elixir Refinement: Able to synthesize and improve Elixir compounds far beyond standard production

characters.name: Felix Manada
characters.description: Young, well-built man who grew up in the Patrician district. Has an electricity-themed power. Dresses in a practical but unstylish hero outfit until Wardrobe redesigns it.
characters.personality: Earnest, idealistic, physically brave. Has a chip on his shoulder about his privileged upbringing. Deeply loyal once trust is established. Easily annoyed by Ryan's jokes but grows to genuinely care for him.
characters.background: Former member of the Augusti organization who left because he couldn't stomach their crimes. Joined Il Migliore to try to make a difference, but found Dynamis too passive. Becomes Ryan's sidekick and eventually a full partner. His family includes sisters Fortuna and Narcinia, and parents aligned with the Augusti.

power_progression.stage: Modulated charges: delayed detonation, thrown objects

special_abilities: Explosive Charge: Charges any solid matter with energy on touch, causing detonation after a delay
Modulated Blast: Learned to control charge size, timing, and throw charged objects as grenades

characters.name: Jasmine Sharif
characters.description: Petite, barely 1.6m tall. Olive skin, sharp black eyes, dark hair bound in a bun by a pencil. Dresses casually in a black shirt, dirtied pants, and unlaced shoes. Pilots an enormous gold-plated power armor nearly 5 meters tall with plasma beams, rockets, cannons, and a fusion reactor.
characters.personality: Fierce, intensely proud, deeply passionate about engineering and explosions. Has a height complex and responds to insults about it with death threats. Became a romantic partner to Ryan across multiple loops. Her sacrifice in certain loops haunts Ryan deeply.
characters.background: A prodigious Genius who once worked as Wyvern's sidekick 'Urban Guerilla' before joining the Augusti. Runs the Augusti's weapons foundry. Controls her power armor via a neural interface (cranial implant).

power_progression.stage: Genius weapons designer with basic armor
Full gold-plated power armor with fusion reactor, plasma beams, neural interface

special_abilities: Genius-level engineering specializing in weapons, robotics, and power systems
Neural Interface: Controls her power armor remotely via a cranial implant
Power Armor: Nearly 5m tall gold-plated suit with plasma beams, rockets, cannons, and miniaturized fusion reactor

characters.name: Jamie
characters.description: Large, calm man with the bearing of a samurai. Manifests a katana of solid crimson light.
characters.personality: Philosophical, measured, loyal to the Augusti hierarchy. Dry wit and takes his duties seriously. Romantically involved with Ki-jung.
characters.background: High-ranking Augusti enforcer and capo. Manages the supply operations division.
special_abilities: Energy Katana: Manifests a perfect replica of a katana made of solid crimson light

characters.name: Ki-jung
characters.description: Korean woman with a pet rat on her shoulder. Carries a complement of trained rats for combat and reconnaissance.
characters.personality: Sharp, perceptive, quietly warm. Deeply loyal to Jamie.
characters.background: Augusti operative and rat-controlling Genome. Romantically involved with Zanbato.
special_abilities: Rat Control: Commands a large number of rats with precision for combat, espionage, and retrieval

characters.name: Lanka
characters.description: Tough, tattooed woman. Has a snake tattoo on her arm she covers with others—a sign of former bandit affiliation. Carries a Beretta 76.
characters.personality: Blunt, pragmatic, occasionally mercenary. Won't harm children, dislikes cruelty to animals. Dry sense of humor.
characters.background: Former member of a savage bandit group (snake tattoo). Now an Augusti operative with an orange sphere-launching power.
special_abilities: Sphere: Fires concentrated orange spheres of energy from joined fingers, causing paralysis or explosive force on impact

characters.name: Luigi
characters.description: African-Italian man, tall, fit, fashionably dressed. Smokes joints casually.
characters.personality: Suspicious, sharp, uses his truth-compelling power liberally. Strong bullshit filter—literally.
characters.background: The Augusti's supply coordinator. Manages logistics. Has a truth-compelling power making him a valuable interrogator.
special_abilities: Truth Compulsion: When someone is speaking to him, they cannot lie or stop telling the truth

characters.name: Nora
characters.description: Amazon-like woman with shoulder-length black hair and sharp greyish eyes. Wears a sleeveless white bodysuit with Dynamis' D-logo. Can grow translucent dragonfly wings and transform into a full draconic form.
characters.personality: Principled, determined, genuinely heroic within the constraints of her corporate situation. Takes her role as New Rome's protector seriously.
characters.background: Il Migliore's premier superheroine and the face of Dynamis' superhero brand. Formerly had Vulcan as a sidekick before the latter went rogue. Becomes genuinely moved when shown proof of Dynamis' corruption.
special_abilities: Dragonfly Wings: Translucent wings allowing silent hovering and supersonic flight
Draconic Transformation: Full transformation into a large dragon
Enhanced Strength: Can bench press a school bus in partial transformation

characters.name: Jupiter Augustus
characters.description: Striking ivory-skinned man near 2 meters tall, with a long beard and a golden laurel crown. Wears a white toga. His entire body is an unnatural ivory alloy. His eyes radiate a crimson glow that can blast lightning.
characters.personality: Supremely arrogant, cold-blooded, contemptuous of normal humans. Considers himself a god. Is dying of cancer. Plans to secure his daughter Livia's succession by destroying all opposition.
characters.background: Near-invincible crime lord who controls most of New Rome's underworld through the Augusti crime syndicate. Ruled the region for decades using Bliss drug production. Has a unique genetic quirk allowing two powers without Psycho side effects. Is dying of cancer.
characters.current_power_level: Unique Dual Genome: Lightning Manifestation + Physical Transcendence (near-invulnerable ivory body)

power_progression.stage: Dual Genome at full power (established before novel's events)

special_abilities: Lightning Blasts: Can project devastating crimson lightning from his eyes and body
Ivory Body: Transformed his body into an extremely hard alloy, making him near-invulnerable
Superhuman Strength: Can cleave through human bodies with a casual backhand

characters.name: Pluto
characters.description: Deathly pale skin. Long bright blue hair. Wears a black Greek chiton dress as her costume, with sandals, a shark-tooth necklace, and skull-shaped earrings.
characters.personality: Utterly composed, intimidating, deeply perceptive. Vaguely amused by Ryan's antics.
characters.background: Augustus's sister and underboss of the Augusti crime family. Her power to will a person to die makes her one of the most feared individuals in New Rome.
special_abilities: Death Will: Can instantly kill any target she wills to die
Age Sensing: Can perceive a being's metaphysical 'age'—detected Ryan's centuries of accumulated temporal weight

characters.name: Livia Augusti
characters.description: Platinum-haired woman. Wears sleeveless black dresses and elegant white hats.
characters.personality: Conflicted between loyalty to her father and her own moral instincts. Has genuine precognitive visions of the future. Ultimately chooses compassion over family loyalty.
characters.background: Daughter of Augustus and heir to the Augusti empire. Has a Violet power allowing her to skip time forward. Works to moderate her father and prevent New Rome from being destroyed.
characters.cultivation_path: Violet Genome / Temporal Perception / Time Skip
special_abilities: Time Skip: Can fast-forward time in her vicinity, causing targets to experience a jump forward
Precognition: Receives visions of possible futures, though limited and imprecise

characters.name: Adam
characters.description: Enormous, obese man whose skin transforms into a shell of hardened carbon. Cheerful, sociable demeanor that masks complete sociopathy.
characters.personality: Cheerful, charismatic, utterly without empathy. Treats mass murder as entertainment. When facing his own mortality, decides to take everyone down with him.
characters.background: Leader of the Meta-Gang. Has taken Elixirs for 15 years and is dying as his powers begin to destabilize. Brought his gang to New Rome to access Mechron's bunker. When Ryan killed Psyshock, Adam fired the Bahamut orbital laser at New Rome in a rage.
characters.current_power_level: Dual Psycho: Carbon Skin + unknown second power
special_abilities: Carbon Skin: Covers his body in a shell of hardened carbon as armor
Unknown second power (unstable due to Psycho condition)

characters.name: Psyshock
characters.description: Tall, slender figure who looks like a shambling doll mimicking a man. Wears heavy black overcoat, hat, scarf, and sunglasses to hide that he is a mass of wires, vestigial flesh, and a skull-like head. Electricity comes from his gloves.
characters.personality: Calculating, cold, possesses a veneer of clinical politeness masking sadistic cruelty. Obsessed with extracting Genius brains. Has known Ryan since before his Elixir days.
characters.background: Adam's second-in-command. A body-jumping telepath who transfers his consciousness between hosts via electrical connection. Known Ryan and Len from their pre-Elixir lives under Bloodstream. Was eventually defeated permanently when Ryan trapped him somewhere he could not jump.
special_abilities: Body Jumping/Possession: Transfers consciousness to another host via electrical connection
Electrokinesis: Generates and manipulates electricity through his gloves and wire body
Brainwave Recognition: Can identify individuals by their unique neural patterns after one connection
Wire Body: Physical form made of wires and vestigial flesh that can extend as tentacles

characters.name: Ghoul
characters.description: Walking, skinless skeleton with vestigial muscles and frozen eyes. An unnatural chilling mist comes from his mouth and nasal cavities, transforming into ice weapons.
characters.personality: Volatile, aggressive, foul-mouthed. Holds grudges intensely.
characters.background: Meta-Gang Psycho with cryokinesis. First encountered attacking Renesco's bar. Repeatedly beaten by Ryan and eventually contained by Dynamis.
special_abilities: Cryokinesis: Creates ice shards, spears, armor, and bridges from ambient moisture
Chill Aura: Releases unnatural mist that drops temperature dramatically

characters.name: Helen
characters.description: Bleached white skin, short golden hair, bloodshot crimson eyes. Sleeveless white shirt and tight shorts. After treatment: shy, apologetic, gentle.
characters.personality: Before treatment: violently insane, obsessed with the 'Purple World,' murderous. After treatment: shy, apologetic, gentle.
characters.background: Meta-Gang Psycho who can summon acid rain and teleport by switching places with raindrops. Her power draws from the Violet dimension. After Alchemo treats her Psycho condition using Mechron's research, she becomes Helen—a quiet, gentle person.
characters.current_power_level: Dual Psycho: Acid Rain / Teleportation (pre-treatment); diminished post-treatment
special_abilities: Acid Summoning: Calls up acid rain clouds capable of corroding metal and dissolving flesh
Teleportation: Switches her position with nearby raindrops at high speed within her acid cloud radius
Purple World Perception: Can perceive and enter the Violet dimension, interfering with Ryan's timestop

characters.name: Sarin
characters.description: Wears a black hazmat suit and gas mask at all times. Gauntlets that can release compressed gas and shockwaves.
characters.personality: Pragmatic, sarcastic toward Ryan's mood swings, occasionally loyal. Becomes Ryan's VP in his 'Meta-Gang President' arc.
characters.background: Meta-Gang Psycho who can project compressed air and toxic gas. Becomes one of Ryan's primary allies when he takes control of the Meta-Gang.
special_abilities: Compressed Air Propulsion: Can fire shockwaves of compressed air
Toxic Gas: Releases harmful chemical gas from her suit

characters.name: Leonard Hargraves
characters.description: Can transform into a pure stellar plasma form. Broad and physically imposing in human form, with a warm and earnest demeanor.
characters.personality: Noble, idealistic, deeply moral. Prefers to offer enemies a chance to stand down. Feels tremendous guilt over lives lost in the Genome Wars.
characters.background: Founder and leader of the Carnival, a wandering pro-bono superhero group. Originally a London firefighter. One of the most powerful beings on Earth. Played a key role in defeating Mechron and tracked down and destroyed Bloodstream.
characters.current_power_level: Red Genome / Living Sun — plasma manipulation, flight, gravity control, extreme durability
special_abilities: Plasma Projection: Can fire devastating plasma beams equivalent to a stellar flare
Solar Transformation: Transforms his body into a living sun, becoming a nearly invulnerable stellar entity
Flight: Moves at fighter-jet and beyond speeds
Gravity Manipulation: Controls his own gravity field
Heart-Core: A dense gravitational core that maintains his body's coherence during plasma transformation

characters.name: Mathias Martel
characters.description: Can turn invisible by manipulating his glass-based armor. Young, earnest, reminds Ryan of Felix.
characters.personality: Serious, analytical, deeply principled. More willing to use lethal force than most heroes but still conflicted about it. Son of the original Pythia (Alice Martel).
characters.background: Member of the Carnival and vanguard operative who arrived in New Rome before Leo's main group. His mother Alice Martel (Pythia) was injured fighting Mechron and he is carrying out her prophetic agenda. Was responsible for assassinating several Augusti Made Men before meeting Ryan.
special_abilities: Glass Control: Telekinetically controls glass and silica, forming shards, walls, spears
Invisibility: Alters his glass armor to refract light, rendering himself invisible
Telepathy (limited): Can read surface thoughts and project images to others

characters.name: Freddie Sabino
characters.description: A Psycho whose body is made of blood he can crystallize and project. Can infect others with his blood, turning them into clones sharing a hive mind.
characters.personality: In his good moments, shows genuine love for Len. Otherwise consumed by his power and mental instability. Hates himself as much as he hates the world.
characters.background: Len's biological father. Ryan's adoptive guardian. Became a Psycho, body degenerating into a blood-construct entity. His genetic code allows him to turn others into clones through blood infection. Was hunted down and destroyed by the Carnival.
characters.current_power_level: Psycho / Unlimited Blood Cloning + Blood Crystallization
special_abilities: Blood Control: Crystallizes and projects his blood as weapons with extreme force
Infectious Cloning: Infects hosts with a drop of his blood, transforming them into copies of himself sharing a hive mind
Unlimited Clones (theoretically): Psychologically limited to about 10 clones but has no biological upper limit
Hive Mind: All active clones share awareness and coordinate

characters.name: Timmy
characters.description: In human form: a young man with white-dyed hair and black spots painted around his eyes. In Panda form: a massive panda larger than a polar bear. Fully regenerates when switching between forms.
characters.personality: Naive, earnest, desperately wants to be taken seriously as a hero. Refers to himself in the third person as 'The Panda.' Becomes fiercely loyal to Ryan as his 'Sifu.'
characters.background: A local vigilante trying to fight crime with only the power to transform into a giant panda. Ryan adopts him as a sidekick and trains him.
special_abilities: Panda Transformation: Becomes a panda larger than a polar bear with enhanced strength and durability
Full Regeneration: Completely heals all injuries when switching between human and panda form

characters.name: Yukiko
characters.description: Japanese woman with an infectiously bright smile. Wears a costume that can change shape to mimic other heroes' outfits.
characters.personality: Enthusiastically fashion-obsessed, cheerful, surprisingly combat-capable. Dreams of having a dedicated arch-nemesis. Is serious about her craft.
characters.background: Il Migliore's resident costume designer and shapeshifter. Her power involves wearing a techno-organic symbiote that can mimic the appearance and some properties of other personas' costumes. Designed Ryan's famous cashmere suit.
special_abilities: Costume Mimicry: Can transform her techno-organic symbiote into any persona's costume, gaining some of that persona's abilities
Theft: By assuming a thief persona, can supernaturally steal items from others' hands

characters.name: Fortuna Manada
characters.description: Blindingly beautiful woman with long golden hair and extravagant fashion. Felix's sister.
characters.personality: Entitled, narcissistic on the surface, but genuinely loves her brother Felix. Obsessively pursues Mathias Martel as a romantic interest.
characters.background: Felix's sister and member of the Augusti family through birth. Has a probability-manipulation power so extreme that things always work out in her favor. Eventually sides with Ryan and Livia against her parents when Felix's life is threatened.
special_abilities: Probability Manipulation: Everything that can go well for her does; extends to finding people, surviving accidents, and affecting the immediate environment

characters.name: Narcinia Manada
characters.description: Younger sister of Felix and Fortuna. Shy in large groups but becomes excited by novel ideas. Can create life from her blood.
characters.personality: Gentle, curious, easily corrupted by Ryan's suggestions. Has a pure heart and strong potential power.
characters.background: Youngest Manada sibling. Her blood-based power to create animals was secretly exploited by Augustus to power the Bliss drug process. Her mother Julie Costa had similar biokinetic powers. Augustus murdered her mother and 'adopted' Narcinia to exploit her ability.
special_abilities: Blood Life Creation: Can create any animal, plant, or chimera from a drop of her own blood

characters.name: Enrique Manada
characters.description: Well-dressed and authoritative. Has a plant-manipulation Genius power. Is Il Migliore's manager.
characters.personality: Genuinely idealistic but bound by family loyalties. Was disgusted by Dynamis' Lab 66 secrets. Willing to reform the company from within.
characters.background: Manager of Il Migliore and son of Hector Manada (Dynamis CEO). Was groomed to be VP but sacked after pushing for social reforms. His brother Alphonse replaced him. Eventually becomes Ryan's key ally inside Dynamis.
special_abilities: Plant Manipulation: Controls plants and botanical matter

characters.name: Hector Manada
characters.description: Elderly CEO of Dynamis.
characters.personality: Conservative, corrupt, obsessed with maintaining the status quo. Made a deal with Augustus allowing the crime lord to operate in exchange for stability.
characters.background: CEO of the Dynamis megacorporation. Father of Enrique and Alphonse. Struck a deal with Augustus to maintain New Rome's corporate peace. Enabled Rust Town's degradation and Psycho exploitations.

characters.name: Alphonse Manada
characters.description: A ghoulish, shining skull—his body undergone nuclear transformation. Radiates lethal radiation that disrupts Genome powers.
characters.personality: Coldly fanatical about ending Augustus's power at any cost. Believes democratizing Elixirs justifies kidnapping Len and threatening children.
characters.background: Replaced his brother Enrique as Dynamis VP after Enrique pushed too hard for reform. Was sent to wage war in Sicily. Eventually reveals his plan to mass-produce Elixirs by exploiting Len's refinement ability.
special_abilities: Nuclear Radiation: Emits lethal radiation that disrupts Genome powers and kills normal humans
Ghoulish Transformation: His body transformed into a radioactive construct

characters.name: Dr. Tyrano
characters.description: Has used an experimental gene-splicing serum to give himself a dinosaur-human hybrid appearance—tail, scales, reptilian features. Has a pet called Tricerador (half-Labrador, half-triceratops).
characters.personality: Intensely passionate about genetic science, dinosaurs, and cloning. Dreams of giving every household a pet dinosaur.
characters.background: Dynamis/Il Migliore's head scientist. Specializes in cloning, gene therapy, and reverse-engineering Elixirs. Made the Hercules Elixir knockoff from Wyvern's genetic material.
characters.current_power_level: Blue Genius / Gene-Splicing Specialist (self-modified into dino-hybrid)
special_abilities: Genius-level genetics and cloning knowledge
Self-modification: Permanently altered his own genome to take dinosaur-hybrid form
Reverse Elixir Engineering: Can synthesize imperfect knockoff Elixirs from Genome DNA samples

characters.name: Alchemo
characters.description: A Genius who has replaced much of his body with cybernetic components including syringe-fingers for direct neural interfacing. His exposed brain interfaces directly with computer systems.
characters.personality: Clinical, emotionally detached, views others as biological systems. Made an artificial daughter (The Doll) and shows rare paternal care toward her.
characters.background: Independent Genius specializing in wetware computing and neural interfaces. Created The Doll as an android daughter. Ryan accessed Mechron's database in exchange for Alchemo helping fix Len's brain-transfer damage.
characters.current_power_level: Blue Genius / Wetware and Cybernetics Expert
special_abilities: Neural Interface: Can directly interface with and control any computer or AI system via syringe-fingers
Wetware Expertise: Creates synthetic brains and consciousness-transfer devices

characters.name: Tea
characters.description: Artificial humanoid with a hidden rocket launcher arm compartment and reinforced metal body beneath artificial skin. Smiles constantly. Has red-glowing eyes.
characters.personality: Warmly devoted to those she considers 'family.' Extremely perceptive emotionally despite being artificial.
characters.background: Alchemo's android daughter with a rocket launcher hidden in her arm. Acts as caretaker at Mechron's bunker during Ryan's Meta-Gang arc.
special_abilities: Rocket Launcher Arm: Hidden rocket launcher compartment in one arm
Reinforced Metal Body: Near-bulletproof, laser-resistant chassis beneath synthetic skin
Enhanced Reflexes: Android-speed reaction time

characters.name: Sarah
characters.description: Brunette girl in an oversized pink dress. Fiercely protective of the orphanage and its children. Treats Len as her mother figure ('Mama').
characters.personality: Stubborn, courageous for her age, pragmatic about violence in a sad way. Idolizes Len.
characters.background: De facto leader among the Rust Town orphan children. Hid a crappy revolver under her dress and threatened Ryan when he first arrived.

characters.name: Giulia Costa
characters.description: Small blonde girl who carries books rather than toys when evacuating. Shy and avoids eye contact with Genomes. Calls Leo Hargraves 'Uncle Leo.'
characters.personality: Quiet, bookish, gentle.
characters.background: Daughter of Julie and Bruno Costa. A second-generation Genome with resistance to sickness, hardened organs, accelerated healing. Her death would trigger Bloodstream's extinction event.
special_abilities: Enhanced Physiology: Resistance to disease, toxins, hardened organs, accelerated healing from birth

characters.name: Renesco
characters.description: Balding, wrinkled old man with tanned skin. Stands behind the counter of the Jolie Wrangler bar.
characters.personality: Surly, suspicious, but ultimately pragmatic. Accepts bribes.
characters.background: Barman at the Jolie Wrangler pub, an Augusti front. Was the recipient of Ryan's first delivery and the first source of information about Len in New Rome.

characters.name: Paulie
characters.description: Scrawny, balding little man. Half-French, half-British. Wears goggles. Runs a disorganized garage-shop in Rust Town.
characters.personality: Bitter about Ryan destroying his old workshop. Grudgingly helpful.
characters.background: Independent tech dealer in Rust Town who knew Len when she operated as the Underdiver. Gave Ryan crucial information about Len's history. His wish—to have the Meta-Gang removed from the Junkyard—was Ryan's first major promise to fulfill.

characters.name: Frank
characters.description: Three-and-a-half meters tall metal titan with a patriotic delusion of being an American president's secret service agent.
characters.personality: Delusional patriot who genuinely believes Ryan is the President of the United States. Extremely loyal to 'Mr. President.'
characters.background: Meta-Gang Psycho. Among the survivors of the Junkyard battle who became Ryan's most loyal soldier in his 'Meta-Gang President' regime.
special_abilities: Iron Body: Near-invulnerable metal physique
Superhuman Strength: Can toss humans through buildings

characters.name: Mongrel
characters.description: A disfiguring metamorph Psycho. Tumors, extra powers, unstable form.
characters.personality: Feral, bestial. Has lost most higher cognitive functions due to Elixir conflicts.
characters.background: A Meta-Gang Psycho who consumed a White Elixir plus almost all knockoff Elixirs available. The result is a being with potentially unlimited powers but a destroyed mind.
special_abilities: Multi-Power Channeling: White Elixir allows him to use more than two abilities simultaneously
Full mutation: Physical form distorted beyond recognition by Elixir conflicts

characters.name: Mosquito
characters.description: Can take a monstrous mosquito-monster form with claw-like hands and wings. Can grow enormous when fully transformed.
characters.personality: Eager for violence and blood.
characters.background: Meta-Gang Psycho with insect transformation. Known for destroying Ryan's Plymouth Fury in one loop.
special_abilities: Insect Transformation: Can become a massive mosquito-monster form with claws, wings, and enormous size

characters.name: The Land
characters.description: A mouthless humanoid with baby-like short legs and a humongous, hairless head. Her true form is almost entirely made of solid dirt with glowing yellow eyes.
characters.personality: Not much personality shown; communicates mainly through gestures.
characters.background: Meta-Gang Psycho with geokinetic powers. Can fuse with and control enormous areas of earth and stone.
special_abilities: Earth Fusion: Merges with the earth itself to control and manipulate stone, soil, and dirt over large areas

characters.name: Mechron
characters.description: Wizened old man in simple white clothes who needs a black cane to walk. Small, unimposing.
characters.personality: Bitter, trauma-fueled, convinced he alone could have saved the world. Driven by grief over the Srebrenica massacre.
characters.background: The rogue Genius dictator who bombed most of Europe and caused the Genome Wars. Specializes in multi-agent AI systems. Created orbital weapons (Kujata and Bahamut satellites), a biomechanical gravity-dragon, and vast drone armies. Was killed by Leo Hargraves when he accidentally opened a portal to a dark dimension.
special_abilities: Multi-Agent AI: Creates AI systems that develop new technologies across all fields
Force Field Generation: Personal and structural force fields
Particle Accelerator: His fortress doubles as a dimensional collider

characters.name: Nidhogg
characters.description: A Danish warlord who can transform into a kilometers-long near-invulnerable reptilian serpent.
characters.personality: Terse, warrior-like. Focused on results.
characters.background: A Green Genome warlord who allied with the Carnival to fight Mechron.
special_abilities: Serpent Transformation: Transforms into a kilometers-long near-invulnerable serpent
Corpse Absorption: Absorbs defeated enemies to regenerate lost biomass
Acid Spit: Can melt fortress walls

characters.name: Julie Costa
characters.description: A biochemist with biokinetic powers. Murdered by Augustus.
characters.personality: Optimistic, compassionate, scientific. Deeply loved her husband Bruno and daughter Giulia.
characters.background: Biochemist who received an Elixir through a Wonderbox. Married Bruno Costa. Was murdered by Augustus when he came to take Narcinia. Giulia's mother.
special_abilities: Biokinesis: Can interact with and modify organic DNA
Environmental Purification: Developed modified plants capable of purifying polluted ecosystems

characters.name: Alice Martel
characters.description: The original Pythia. Co-founder of the Carnival with Leo. Now recovering from injuries sustained fighting Mechron.
characters.personality: Her presence is mostly through references and the legacy she left.
characters.background: One of the founding members of the Carnival alongside Leo Hargraves. A powerful precognitive Genome who compiled detailed predictions of global threats including Bloodstream's extinction scenario. Severely injured during the battle with Mechron. Her son Mathias (Shroud) is carrying on her mission.
special_abilities: Precognition: Could see the future with significant detail; compiled detailed threat assessments for years

characters.name: The Cossack
characters.description: Member of the Carnival. Man of few words and extreme directness. Moves at incredible speed.
characters.personality: Laconic, action-oriented, focused on efficiency.
characters.background: Carnival member who fought alongside Leo in major battles. Caught the Kujata satellite single-handedly by flying after it at g-force crushing speeds.
special_abilities: Supersonic Flight: Can move at speeds sufficient to catch orbital launch vehicles
G-Force Resistance: Capable of enduring crushing g-forces

characters.name: Ace
characters.description: Carnival member. Focus on evacuation and support roles during major battles.
characters.personality: Organized and empathetic.
characters.background: Member of the Carnival. Fought alongside Leo at Mechron's fortress.

characters.name: Stitch
characters.description: Wears a plague doctor costume. Carnival's biologist/medic.
characters.personality: Precise, clinical, calm even when delivering horrifying information.
characters.background: Carnival member specializing in biological threats. Analyzed Bloodstream's samples and discovered he has no biological upper limit to his clones.

characters.name: Mr. Wave
characters.description: Boastful Genome. Ryan finds him 'cringey' but admits to finding him cool when truth-compelled.
characters.personality: Arrogant and show-off. Has hard limits about harming children.
characters.background: Carnival member and well-known superhero.

characters.name: Jean-Stéphanie
aliases: His Highness Jean-Stéphanie the First, Sovereign Prince of Monaco
characters.description: A creature/Genome who rules Monaco. Described as having elongated arms, distorted facial features, and wearing a suit with a fedora.
characters.personality: Unknown—communicates only through announcements over loudspeakers and his clown servants.
characters.background: The ruler of Monaco after the apocalypse. Claims to have ascended to the throne 'by virtue of everyone else being dead.' Commands an army of golden-masked clown constructs who eat unwelcome guests. Monaco is a place 'nobody returns from.'
special_abilities: Clown Constructs: Commands masked clown entities that can disable Genome powers within Monaco's territory
Power Negation Zone: Something within Monaco prevents Genome powers from activating

characters.name: Minerva
characters.description: Pluto's niece. Blue Genome.
characters.personality: Not directly depicted.
characters.background: Pluto's niece with the ability to interact with parallel universes. Pluto wonders how her ability would interact with Ryan's temporal powers.
special_abilities: Parallel Universe Interaction: Can interact with alternate realities

characters.name: Sparrow
characters.description: Pluto's bodyguard. Has a black uniform and assault rifle. Thoroughly professional.
characters.personality: Loyal, competent.
characters.background: Pluto's personal bodyguard and hunting partner.

characters.name: Eva Fabre
characters.description: Short black hair, blue eyes, unremarkable appearance. Has not aged in over a decade. Can teleport across continents within minutes.
characters.personality: Unknown. Tracks suggest methodical and dangerous.
characters.background: Former lead geneticist at France's secret biological weapons laboratory 'Station Orpheon' in Antarctica. In 1992, a purple flash and crash preceded all 22 other researchers dying. Eva's body was never found. In the present she distributes fake vaccines through 'New H' that turn recipients into monsters.
special_abilities: Global Teleportation: Can move between two sides of the Earth within an hour
Anti-aging: Has not visibly aged since 1992

characters.name: Cardinal Andreas Torque
characters.description: Catholic Cardinal. Elderly, deeply experienced.
characters.personality: Methodical, deeply religious, pragmatic about evil.
characters.background: Leader of the Malleus Maleficarum, a Church organization investigating supernatural and Genome incidents. Currently tracking Eva Fabre and the monster incidents.

characters.name: The Alchemist
characters.description: Never directly seen in the novel. Distributed Wonderboxes containing Elixirs to seemingly random people around the world, setting off the Genome Wars.
characters.personality: Inscrutable. Possibly intended to create a new race of superhumans capable of breeding.
characters.background: The mysterious figure responsible for creating and distributing the Elixirs that gave humans superpowers, triggering the Genome Wars. The Elixirs behave like viruses—alive, intelligent to a degree, and selective in their bonding.
special_abilities: Elixir Creation: Created the Wonderboxes and their Elixirs that grant superpowers

power_system.name: Elixir Genome System
power_system.description: Superpowers come from Elixirs—living semi-intelligent substances distributed in 'Wonderboxes' by the mysterious Alchemist during 'Last Easter.' When an Elixir bonds to a human, it rewrites the host's DNA to make them the vessel of a unique power drawn from a parallel dimension corresponding to the Elixir's color. Each power is unique (no two Genomes have exactly the same ability) though powers may be variants. An Elixir only bonds to one person even when divided into doses. Normal humans cannot bond with a second Elixir without conflict; taking two causes the Elixirs to fight over the genetic code, producing 'Psychos'—beings with two powers but unstable genetics who must periodically inject more Elixirs to stabilize. Rare individuals (like Augustus) have a genetic quirk allowing two powers to coexist without conflict. Knockoff Elixirs ('serums') are imperfect copies that give a fraction of a real power. Elixirs guide their hosts subtly and compel Psychos to seek more doses. Genomes are resistant to disease and age slowly.

tiers.name: Normal Human
tiers.description: Baseline humanity with no Elixir bonding.

tiers.name: Knockoff Genome
tiers.description: Human who consumed a synthetic 'serum' (knockoff Elixir), gaining a weak fraction of a genuine power. Widely marketed products like the 'Hercules Elixir' and 'Tempest' serum fall here.
tiers.breakthrough_requirements: Purchase and consumption of a commercial Knockoff Elixir

tiers.name: Genome (Standard)
tiers.description: Human who bonded with a genuine Alchemist Elixir. Possesses one unique superpower and general physical enhancement.
power_feats: Highly individual based on power type; generally superhuman in their field
tiers.breakthrough_requirements: Bonding with an Alchemist Elixir; no repeatable process known

tiers.name: Psycho (Dual Elixir)
tiers.description: A human who has taken two or more Elixirs. Gains two powers but their genetic code becomes permanently unstable. Must periodically inject more Elixirs to stabilize. Often experience mental deterioration and physical mutation.
tiers.breakthrough_requirements: Consuming a second genuine Elixir after already bonding with one

tiers.name: Unique Dual Genome (No Side Effects)
tiers.description: Extraordinarily rare individuals who can channel two Elixir powers without Psycho deterioration. The two Elixirs coexist independently rather than conflicting.
power_feats: Two full superhuman abilities with no mental or physical deterioration
tiers.breakthrough_requirements: Specific genetic predisposition; cannot be reliably replicated

tiers.name: Genius (Blue Genome)
tiers.description: Humans whose Elixir enhances their intelligence to superhuman levels, connecting them to the 'Akashic Records'—a dimension of pure information. The most dangerous long-term due to their technological output.
power_feats: Technology that defies current scientific understanding

special_constitutions.name: Unique Dual Genome Constitution
special_constitutions.description: An extraordinarily rare genetic trait that allows a human to bond with two Elixirs without the conflicts that cause the Psycho condition. The two Elixirs modify different DNA sequences or otherwise coexist independently.
advantages: Two full superpowers with no mental deterioration
disadvantages: Extremely rare; cannot be reliably identified or replicated
special_constitutions.lore: Augustus is the most famous known case. Dr. Tyrano noted that Augustus's two powers lack obvious synergy, suggesting they truly coexist independently.

special_constitutions.name: Second-Generation Genome
special_constitutions.description: Children born to two Genome parents inherit secondary mutations without taking an Elixir: enhanced healing, resistance to disease and toxins, hardened organs.
advantages: May eventually gain full powers without an Elixir
special_constitutions.lore: Julie Costa suspected the Alchemist's goal was to create a new breeding race of superhumans, making the Second-Generation the fulfillment of this agenda.

daos_or_paths.name: Violet Path (Temporal Powers)
daos_or_paths.description: Powers drawn from a Violet dimension of pure time and probability. Violet Genomes can manipulate time in various ways: stopping it, skipping it forward, rewinding to save points, or perceiving the 'Purple World' between moments. Violet powers interfere with each other when two Violet Genomes use their abilities simultaneously.

daos_or_paths.name: Red Path (Energy Powers)
daos_or_paths.description: Powers drawn from a Red dimension of energy, plasma, and gravity. Includes fire, plasma beams, gravity manipulation, light swords, and electrical powers. The most combat-oriented path.

daos_or_paths.name: Blue Path (Intellect Powers / Akashic Records)
daos_or_paths.description: Powers drawn from a Blue dimension of pure information called the Akashic Records. Blue Genomes become Geniuses with superhuman intelligence. Some develop perception-based powers like precognition.

daos_or_paths.name: Green Path (Organic Powers)
daos_or_paths.description: Powers drawn from a Green dimension of organic matter. Green Genomes gain power over living things: animals, plants, their own biological transformation, or even DNA. The most diverse path.

daos_or_paths.name: Orange Path (Chemical/Matter Powers)
daos_or_paths.description: Powers drawn from an Orange dimension of chemical manipulation. Orange Genomes can manipulate chemicals, create energy spheres, summon acid, or charge objects with explosive energy.

daos_or_paths.name: White Path (Adaptive/Mimicry Powers)
daos_or_paths.description: Extremely rare White Elixirs grant adaptive or mimicry-based powers. The White Genome can potentially channel multiple powers. Mongrel's White Elixir allowed him to use powers beyond the normal two-Elixir limit.

regression_loops.note: The novel tracks Ryan's loops by date. May 8th 2020 is the primary save point.
regression_loops.trigger: Ryan's first death in New Rome (ice spear from Ghoul through the chest)
regression_loops.outcome: Ryan successfully completes delivery and defeats Ghoul using car + baseball bat

regression_loops.trigger: Ryan killed by Psyshock's allies (DNA tracker ambush at ship graveyard)
key_changes: Learns about Shroud and the Carnival's presence
regression_loops.outcome: Fails; Psyshock survives and Adam gets orbital weapon access

regression_loops.trigger: New Rome destroyed by Bahamut orbital laser after Meta-Gang gains full bunker control
key_changes: Ryan defeats Adam but New Rome is already destroyed
regression_loops.outcome: Bad Ending — Ryan resets; learns he must address bunker sooner

regression_loops.trigger: Psyshock body-jumps into Len via brain-transfer procedure
regression_loops.outcome: Psyshock captures Ryan; Ryan eventually resets

regression_loops.trigger: Dynamis submarine forces and Alphonse threaten the underwater base
key_changes: Len activated brain-transfer; Len survives but procedure has side effects
regression_loops.outcome: Partial success — proof of concept works

key_changes: Len successfully transfers her memories across loops via improved brain-copy machine
Ryan reunites with Len who remembers
regression_loops.outcome: SUCCESS — The Perfect Run achieved; Len remembers Ryan; Ryan no longer alone

techniques.name: Quicksave (Save Point)
techniques.description: Ryan can designate a specific moment in time as a 'save point.' Upon death or activation, his consciousness returns to that moment with full memory of all events that occurred after it.
effects: Restores Ryan to save point moment on death
Retains all memories from the erased loop
The rest of the universe's state reverts to the save point moment
weaknesses: Can only set one save point at a time
Save point requires conscious action to establish
Cannot carry physical objects or other people across loops
techniques.lore: The save point is Ryan's ace in the hole that he never reveals. Over centuries of loops, he accumulated vast knowledge through repetition. The ability also accumulates 'metaphysical weight'—the impression of great age detected by Pluto.

techniques.name: Time Stop
techniques.description: Ryan momentarily freezes all observable time, creating a 'Purple World' of frozen moments in which he can move freely.
effects: Freezes all matter and energy except Ryan himself
Creates the 'Purple World' (violet-tinted frozen reality)
Allows repositioning, aiming, and counterattacking within frozen time
weaknesses: Acid Rain and other Violet Genomes can sense and react to its activation
Cannot stop time within Monaco's territory
techniques.lore: The Purple World is the frozen-time space between moments. Acid Rain, also a Violet Genome, can perceive and partially act within it, making her one of Ryan's hardest counters.

techniques.name: Time Skip
techniques.description: Livia Augusti can fast-forward time in her local area, causing targets (and herself) to skip forward in time without experiencing the intervening moments.
effects: Affected targets lose consciousness of skipped time
Can use skipped time to reposition herself or strike
Disrupts even Ryan's memory of events during the skip
weaknesses: Unknown limits on distance and duration
techniques.lore: Ryan speculates Livia's mother was the Violet Genome who contributed this power, and Augustus only has the lightning side.

techniques.name: Acid Rain Teleportation
techniques.description: Acid Rain can switch her position with any raindrop within her acid cloud's radius, effectively teleporting anywhere inside her weather effect.
effects: Teleportation within acid cloud range
Can appear from any angle within the rain
Acts faster than Ryan's timestop (smaller spatial scope)
weaknesses: Limited to her acid cloud's range
Cannot teleport outside the rain boundary
techniques.lore: The interference between Acid Rain's Violet teleportation and Ryan's Violet time-stop made her one of his most dangerous opponents.

techniques.name: Solar Transformation
techniques.description: Leo Hargraves can transform his entire body into a living star, becoming a stellar plasma entity. His heart-core—a dense gravitational center—maintains his body's coherence during transformation.
effects: Transforms body into living plasma/stellar fire
Near-invulnerability in solar form
Plasma beams powerful enough to melt fortress walls
Flight at mach speeds
weaknesses: Dark dimensional forces can consume even his solar body
The dragon's gravitational field could suppress his movement
techniques.lore: Even going supernova couldn't destroy Augustus in one loop. The Heart-Core is the only thing keeping Leo's plasma body from dispersing.

techniques.name: Plasma Beam
techniques.description: Ranged projection of superheated plasma capable of melting steel and destroying force fields.
effects: Melts metal on contact
Can disable energy force fields
weaknesses: Can be countered by sufficiently powerful force fields

techniques.name: Crimson Light Katana
techniques.description: Zanbato manifests a perfect replica of a katana made of solid crimson light.
effects: Sharp enough to cut through most materials
Appears on command

techniques.name: Truth Compulsion (Veritas)
techniques.description: Luigi's power forces anyone speaking to him to be compelled to tell the truth and cannot stop mid-sentence once they begin.
effects: Forces complete honesty in anyone addressing Luigi
Cannot be resisted by will alone
weaknesses: The person can decline to speak at all
techniques.lore: Ryan warned Luigi that someday he would ask the wrong question and get an answer he didn't want to hear.

techniques.name: Death Will
techniques.description: Pluto can will any being to die, with no warning, no protection, and no counter according to available information.
effects: Instant death to the target with no mechanism described
No physical contact required
weaknesses: Unknown limits; Ryan's save point allows him to 'survive' it by reverting
techniques.lore: She also has an 'age sensing' ability that lets her perceive a being's metaphysical weight of years—detecting Ryan's centuries of accumulated temporal mass.

techniques.name: Blood Infection (Bloodstream Cloning)
techniques.description: Bloodstream can infect any being with a circulatory system with a single drop of his blood, transforming the host into a clone of himself sharing his hive mind.
effects: Transforms infected hosts into Bloodstream clones
Clones share his powers and hive mind awareness
Can infect humans and animals
No theoretical upper limit on clone count
weaknesses: Psychological trauma limits his willing use of full potential
Carnival's containment strategy: isolate and incinerate all clones simultaneously
techniques.lore: The Carnival discovered Bloodstream's limit of 10 clones is entirely psychological. If fully unleashed, he could theoretically infect all life on Earth within months.

techniques.name: Explosive Charge
techniques.description: Felix charges any solid matter with energy on touch, causing detonation after a delay. With practice, can modulate charge size and timing.
effects: Charges objects with explosive Red Flux energy
Delayed detonation (controllable timing)
Can throw charged objects as grenades
weaknesses: Cannot charge energy or non-solid matter
techniques.lore: Dr. Tyrano identified that Felix's charges use 'Red Flux'—the same energy dimension that powers Leo and Zanbato's abilities, just expressed differently through his unique Orange Elixir.

techniques.name: Panda Transformation and Regeneration
techniques.description: Timmy transforms into a massive panda and completely heals all injuries when switching between human and panda form.
effects: Full physical healing on every transformation
Enhanced strength and durability in panda form
Can be transformed repeatedly to heal
weaknesses: In panda form can only eat bamboo (meat causes revulsion)
techniques.lore: Ryan's training regimen for the Panda: 'You get hit. You become panda. You heal. You hit back.' Simple but brutally effective.

artifacts.name: Plymouth Fury (Ryan's Car)
artifacts.description: A highly customized red Plymouth Fury. Self-driving via a synthetic wetware brain in a hidden hatch under the hood. Also houses the Chronoradio. Frequently destroyed and replaced.
abilities: Hidden compartments for weapons and equipment
Can be remotely summoned by Ryan's whistle
artifacts.origin: Ryan's personal vehicle, modified over countless loops
artifacts.lore: The car's synthetic brain is a wetware computer grown in a jar by a client Genius. It also powers the Chronoradio. The discovery of the brain in the car is a major comedic moment when Ryan's allies find it.

artifacts.name: The Rabbit Plushie (WMD)
artifacts.description: A white rabbit plushie that is Ryan's most destructive weapon. When activated via a switch on its back, it releases an uncontrollable energy effect that devastates everything in range. Has since developed sentience and entered a suicidal phase.
abilities: Uncontrollable energy release capable of killing near-invulnerable beings
Has begun developing independent behavior (reproduces, plays dead, commits increasingly creative suicide attempts)
Cannot be permanently destroyed by conventional means
artifacts.origin: Built by Ryan in an unsupervised experiment
artifacts.lore: The plushie is genuinely feared by knowledgeable parties. It has since developed enough awareness to attempt suicide (trying guns, ropes, water buckets with jumper cables).

artifacts.name: Chronoradio
artifacts.description: A radio that can tap into alternate timelines and pick up broadcasts from parallel pasts. Powered by the synthetic brain in Ryan's Plymouth Fury. Used by Ryan to communicate across loops after Len develops the brain-transfer mechanism.
abilities: Receives radio broadcasts from alternate parallel timelines
Used as a communication device across time loops after Len's modification
artifacts.origin: Ryan assembled it from Genius-built components over multiple loops
artifacts.lore: It eventually becomes the device through which Len communicates with Ryan across loops, confirming the success of the brain-transfer at the start of the Perfect Run.

artifacts.name: The Fisty Brothers (Pisto-Gauntlets)
artifacts.description: Metallic gauntlets with hydraulic piston-powered rams. Based on Mechron-era pisto-gauntlet designs, upgraded with electrical shock effects.
abilities: Enhanced physical strikes against Genome-level durability targets
artifacts.origin: Based on Mechron drone technology; Ryan's personal customization
artifacts.lore: Ryan calls them 'The Fisty Brothers' and claims they are the real A-bombs of the world.

artifacts.name: Coil Gun
artifacts.description: A coilgun that fires projectiles faster and more powerfully than conventional firearms, capable of punching through Genome-level materials.
abilities: Fires magnetically-accelerated projectiles at extreme velocity
Can penetrate robot armor and energy shields that bullets cannot

artifacts.name: Laser Blade
artifacts.description: A handheld energy blade that can cut through most materials.
abilities: Projects a blade of focused energy
Can cut through standard Genome-resistant materials

artifacts.name: A-Bomb (Miniaturized Nuclear Device)
artifacts.description: A miniaturized nuclear explosive that Ryan carries as a deterrent. Eventually manufactures several using Mechron's matter replicator.
artifacts.origin: Originally built by Ryan; later replicated using Mechron's bunker technology
artifacts.lore: Vulcan immediately confiscated Ryan's original A-bomb as a 'respect tax' for insulting her about Wyvern.

artifacts.name: Underdiver Armor (JIM Suit)
artifacts.description: A large diving suit built from scavenged materials by Len. Resembles an Old World JIM diving suit but modified with weapons systems including a minigun. Crimson-painted.
artifacts.origin: Built by Len Sabino from scavenged parts in Rust Town
artifacts.lore: Paulie helped Len maintain the suit by providing parts. It was her calling card as 'The Underdiver.'

artifacts.name: Len's Bathyspheres
artifacts.description: Spherical undersea vehicles with no cables—powered by propellers. Crimson-painted, steampunk-influenced design.
artifacts.lore: Ryan recognized these immediately as Len's work—the fondness for steampunk aesthetic, rugged efficiency, and crimson paint.

artifacts.name: The Laika (Submarine)
artifacts.description: Len's personal submarine. Three-room layout: machinery room, supply storage, and living quarters with bunk bed and control panel.
abilities: Small enough to be operated by one person
artifacts.origin: Built by Len Sabino before the novel begins
artifacts.lore: The Laika was the submarine Len and Ryan used to flee from the Carnival when Bloodstream was being hunted.

artifacts.name: Len's Undersea Habitat
artifacts.description: A 50 m² apartment built on the seafloor, accessible via an airlock. Blue and red painted walls. Has kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, and main room with a porthole overlooking the abyss.
artifacts.origin: Built by Len Sabino near Ischia Island
artifacts.lore: Ryan finds this place when Vulcan takes him there in her suit. It is both Len's sanctuary and her prison.

artifacts.name: Vulcan's Power Armor
artifacts.description: Nearly 5 meters tall, gold-plated power armor. Cockpit located between the shoulders. Controlled via neural interface (Vulcan's cranial implant). Houses plasma beams, rockets, cannons, and a miniaturized fusion reactor.
abilities: Can enter undersea mode for deep diving
artifacts.origin: Designed and built by Jasmine Sharif (Vulcan)
artifacts.lore: Vulcan designed the cockpit between the shoulders specifically to avoid the standard 'center-of-mass' targeting that Dynamis soldiers use.

artifacts.name: Mechron's Fortress (Sarajevo)
artifacts.description: A massive fortress built in an infinity-symbol shape in Sarajevo. Doubles as a particle accelerator. Has a command center, biomechanical brains (AI supercomputers), force fields, a collider, and housed a dimensional portal to the Akashic Records.
abilities: AI-controlled armies of drones and robots
artifacts.lore: The fortress was destroyed in the battle between Leo and Mechron. The dark dimension portal that appeared consumed Mechron and destroyed the fortress.

artifacts.name: Bahamut (Orbital Laser)
artifacts.description: An enormous orbital weapon the size of a skyscraper. Has enough firepower to devastate a city from orbit.
abilities: Orbital laser bombardment capable of destroying entire city blocks
artifacts.lore: The Bahamut was the weapon Adam the Ogre eventually gained partial control over, using it to devastate New Rome.

artifacts.name: Kujata (Orbital Weapon)
artifacts.description: A second orbital weapon launched alongside the Bahamut from Mechron's fortress.
artifacts.lore: The Cossack managed to bring down the Kujata by catching up to it and destroying it before it reached a stable orbit.

artifacts.name: Mechron's Scorpion Mech (Toasty)
artifacts.description: An enormous Mechron-made combat mech reprogrammed by Ryan with a new 'Toasty' personality matrix. Has spider legs, weapon systems, and enormous firepower.
abilities: Reprogrammed AI personality loves destroying things
artifacts.origin: Built by Mechron; reprogrammed by Ryan
artifacts.lore: Toasty guards the entrance to Mechron's bunker during Ryan's Meta-Gang President arc.

artifacts.name: Tricerador
artifacts.description: Half-Labrador, half-triceratops chimera created by Dr. Tyrano. Has three horns, a dog's wagging tail, and makes saurian sounds.
artifacts.lore: Ryan immediately forgives Tyrano's many crimes upon seeing the creature, realizing someone who wants dinosaur pets can't be all bad.

pills_and_resources.name: Violet Elixir
effects: Grants one unique Violet-path superpower to the bonded Genome
side_effects: None if first Elixir; triggers Psycho condition if combined with another

pills_and_resources.name: Red Elixir
effects: Grants one unique Red-path superpower (energy, plasma, fire, gravity)
side_effects: None if first; Psycho condition if combined

pills_and_resources.name: Blue Elixir
effects: Connects the Genome to the Akashic Records, granting superhuman intelligence and Genius-level insight
side_effects: None if first; Psycho condition if combined

pills_and_resources.name: Green Elixir
effects: Grants organic/biological manipulation powers
side_effects: None if first; Psycho condition if combined

pills_and_resources.name: White Elixir
effects: Grants adaptive/mimicry powers; allows the host to channel more than two Elixirs without them cannibalizing each other
side_effects: Still subject to Elixir conflicts and addiction if combined with others

pills_and_resources.name: Bliss
effects: Highly addictive euphoric drug
side_effects: Responsible for approximately 20,000 deaths per year across Italy, Spain, France, Turkey, Libya
ingredients: Manufactured at the Bliss Factory on Ischia Island

pills_and_resources.name: Rampage
effects: Greatly extends time-stop duration
Enhanced physical performance

pills_and_resources.name: Hercules Elixir
effects: Grants minor enhanced strength based on Wyvern's power sample
side_effects: Significantly weaker than a true Elixir
ingredients: Wyvern's genetic material synthesized by Dr. Tyrano

pills_and_resources.name: Tempest Serum
effects: Grants minor aerokinesis to the user
side_effects: Significantly weaker than a true Genome wind power

beasts_and_creatures.name: Eugène-Henry von Schrödinger
beasts_and_creatures.description: Ryan's cat. After the events of the Psyshock attack, appears to partially exist in the Violet/Purple dimension. Randomly teleports.
abilities: Apparent teleportation (possibly switching between the Purple World and reality)
Livia cannot perceive it clearly—suggests existence across two realities simultaneously

named_individuals.name: Eugène-Henry von Schrödinger
named_individuals.notes: Ryan's beloved cat. Named after Schrödinger's thought experiment. Has absorbed Violet Flux and gained unusual powers.

beasts_and_creatures.lore: Ryan theorizes Eugène-Henry partially exists in the Purple World, making him a Schrödinger's Cat in a literal sense—existing in two states simultaneously.

beasts_and_creatures.name: Mechron's Biomechanical Dragon
beasts_and_creatures.description: A 10-meter-tall European dragon with solar-sail wings. Red scales mixed with black machinery covering the chest, head, and claws. One of Mechron's most advanced creations—proves Mechron could give Elixirs to non-human entities.
abilities: Gravity Control: Can project crushing gravitational forces or create wormholes to deflect attacks
Wormhole Creation: Can open miniature black holes to teleport itself or redirect enemy attacks
beasts_and_creatures.lore: Mechron reverse-engineered the Elixir process to give this creature powers. It was the first known case of a non-human gaining Genome abilities.

beasts_and_creatures.name: Darkling (The Shoggoth)
beasts_and_creatures.description: A mass of black ooze that slithers like a shadow. Can flow through surfaces. Negates Genome powers in its vicinity. Dissolves Elixir-infused materials on contact.
abilities: Ooze Form: Can flow through cracks and over surfaces
Power Negation: Proximity negates Genome abilities
Elixir Dissolution: Can dissolve Elixir-infused liquids and portals by absorbing them

named_individuals.name: Darkling
named_individuals.notes: Ryan's unusual pet from a dark dimension. Has since returned 'home' to its dimension.

beasts_and_creatures.lore: Ryan acquired Darkling as a pet from some unknown dark dimension encounter. It briefly appears in the bunker battle where it consumes Mechron's telekinetic guard-robot.

beasts_and_creatures.name: Monaco Clown Constructs
beasts_and_creatures.description: Human-like entities with unnaturally white skin and gold, silver, or bronze croupier masks for faces. Eyes and mouth ooze darkness. Wear croupier costumes.
abilities: Carry cutlery and napkins—eat unwelcome guests
beasts_and_creatures.lore: Created by or serving Jean-Stéphanie, Sovereign Prince of Monaco. Monaco is a place 'nobody returns from' because these entities eat any guest who overstays their welcome.

beasts_and_creatures.name: Stanford Monster (James Poole)
beasts_and_creatures.description: A white-skinned, faceless beast six meters tall with abnormally long arms and a glowing light where the face should be. Surrounded by blue mist that turns people feral.
abilities: Feral contagion aura: Blue mist causes people to go feral

named_individuals.name: James Poole
named_individuals.notes: Former repairman transformed via fake vaccine from Eva Fabre's company 'New H.' Escaped into the Mojave Desert.

beasts_and_creatures.lore: Connected to Eva Fabre's 'New H' company and the Malleus Maleficarum's investigation.

locations.name: New Rome
locations.description: The largest metropolis in Italy, built around the shores of the Gulf of Naples after Mechron's drones bombed the original city. Has the tallest buildings in what remains of Italy, anchored by the Dynamis Tower to the north. Divided into wealthy districts (Golden Coast, Patrician District) and the impoverished, walled-off Rust Town to the northwest.
locations.lore: New Rome was rebuilt by Dynamis megacorporation money after Mechron's bombing of Naples. Operates under a Cold War-like detente between Dynamis/Il Migliore and the Augusti.

locations.name: Rust Town
locations.description: New Rome's poor northwest neighborhood, walled off from the rest of the city. Home to industrial plants whose pollution turns the air sickly yellow. Has a Junkyard at its center where Geniuses once traded.
locations.lore: Rust Town's population consists of displaced original inhabitants of the Gulf of Naples. The area is deliberately kept degraded to separate the underclass from New Rome's wealthy districts.

locations.name: The Junkyard
locations.description: An old coal mine transformed into an open landfill at the center of Rust Town. Taken over by the Meta-Gang. Conceals the entrance to Mechron's hidden bunker below.
locations.lore: The Junkyard's transformation into molten trash after the Mechron bunker battle conveniently hides the bunker's entrance from Dynamis.

locations.name: Mechron's Secret Bunker (New Rome)
locations.description: A massive underground complex beneath the Junkyard. Contains labs, a holographic observatory, a futuristic armory, a miniature particle collider, an AI systems network, and an Orbital Communications Center that controls the Bahamut satellite. Has an underwater access point.
dangers: Connection to the Bahamut orbital weapon
locations.lore: One of Mechron's backup bases. Contains data backups of all Mechron's research, including secrets of the Elixir system, methods to cure the Psycho condition, and the Bahamut firing controls.

locations.name: Ischia Island (Bliss Factory)
locations.description: An island off the coast of New Rome where the Augusti operate their fortress-lab producing the Bliss drug.
dangers: Orbital laser strike in bad loops
locations.lore: The Bliss Factory on Ischia is the economic engine of the Augusti criminal empire.

locations.name: Monaco
locations.description: The former luxury microstate on the French Riviera, somehow preserved from the apocalypse. Buildings intact, streets empty. Controlled by Jean-Stéphanie and his clown constructs. Genome powers cannot activate within its territory.
locations.lore: Monaco is 'the place nobody returns from.' Ryan visited it during his years of searching for Len and barely escaped. His powers didn't work there.

locations.name: Il Migliore Tower
locations.description: Il Migliore's headquarters tower in New Rome. Houses hero apartments, Dr. Tyrano's lab, Wardrobe's fashion floor, Star Studios, and the corporate infrastructure of Dynamis' superhero brand.
locations.lore: The tower is as much a marketing operation as a hero base. Ryan attends an orientation video and decides to hack the company instead.

locations.name: Vulcan's Foundry (Little Maghreb)
locations.description: The Augusti's weapon production facility in Little Maghreb. Appears to be an ordinary foundry but houses a full weapon manufacturing operation.
locations.lore: Nobody is stupid enough to attack Vulcan's foundry, including Private Security and Il Migliore. Site of Ryan's first meeting with Vulcan.

locations.name: Rust Town Orphanage and Animal Shelter
locations.description: A combined orphanage and animal shelter in the south of Rust Town. Crumbling cinder block building with a large fenced area for hundreds of stray cats and dogs. Operated by Len as a safe haven.
locations.lore: The orphanage is Len's primary reason to remain near the surface. Ryan's defense of the orphanage from Psyshock is a turning point in his relationship with Len.

locations.name: Jolie Wrangler Pub
locations.description: An unremarkable pub in New Rome's Golden Coast tourist district. An Augusti front business run by Renesco. Scene of Ryan's first delivery and Ghoul's first attack.
locations.lore: Site of Ryan's first death in the novel.

locations.name: Mechron's Fortress (Sarajevo)
locations.description: The massive infinity-symbol-shaped fortress in Sarajevo that served as Mechron's primary base. Now destroyed after Leo's assault and the dark dimensional event.
locations.lore: The site where Leo Hargraves killed Mechron and the dark dimension portal opened. Something within the portal 'gazed back' and destroyed Mechron completely.

locations.name: Len's Undersea Habitat (Ischia Seafloor)
locations.description: Len's 50m² apartment on the seafloor near Ischia, accessible via airlock large enough for Vulcan's armor. Has kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, and porthole overlooking the abyss.
dangers: Dynamis submarine attacks in later arcs
locations.lore: Ryan finds this place when Vulcan transports him there in her suit. It is both Len's sanctuary and her prison—she never goes above the surface.

realms_and_dimensions.name: The Purple World (Violet Dimension)
realms_and_dimensions.description: The dimension from which all Violet Genomes draw their temporal powers. Experienced by Ryan as a purple-hued frozen world during timestop. Acid Rain described it as 'paradise.' Contains temporal energy and probability manipulation.
access_methods: Acid Rain could partially enter it through teleportation
realms_and_dimensions.lore: Ryan occasionally perceives the Purple World's edges when using his powers intensely. Acid Rain was obsessed with accessing it fully.

realms_and_dimensions.name: The Akashic Records (Blue World)
realms_and_dimensions.description: A dimension of pure intellect and information. The source of Blue Elixir powers and the Genius ability. Contains 'all data, all information, all knowledge, all intent, and emotions.' Mechron attempted to access it directly through his particle collider, instead opening a portal to the dark dimension.
realms_and_dimensions.lore: Images from the Akashic Records showed Leo scenes from his life, then alien worlds covered in oceans. Mechron called it 'the universal compendium—the source of all powers.'

realms_and_dimensions.name: The Dark Dimension (The Abyss)
realms_and_dimensions.description: An unknown dimension of pure void and nothingness. When Mechron's particle collider accidentally opened a portal to it, it emitted a 'pulse of darkness' that vaporized the biomechanical brains and disintegrated Mechron atom-by-atom. Something within it 'gazed back.'
access_methods: Mechron's particle collider accidentally opened it
Darkling may have come from here
realms_and_dimensions.lore: 'The abyss gazed back.' This dark gaze began unraveling Leo's solar body and destroyed Mechron completely. Pythia could only see black where the future should be regarding this threat.

factions.name: The Augusti
factions.description: The dominant crime family of New Rome and most of Italy. Controls Bliss drug production, weapons manufacturing through Vulcan's foundry, and numerous legitimate fronts. Has a Cold War-like detente with Dynamis.
factions.history: Founded by Jupiter Augustus using his near-invincible powers and ruthless ambition. Built the Bliss drug empire to fund an army of Genome enforcers. Augustus is dying of cancer and plans one final push to ensure Livia's succession.
factions.lore: The three Augustus siblings (Jupiter/Augustus, Pluto, Neptune) use Roman deity names. Augustus sees himself as a Roman god-emperor.

factions.name: The Meta-Gang
factions.description: A Psycho gang led by Adam the Ogre. All members are Psychos who came to New Rome seeking access to Mechron's bunker to find a cure for their degenerating Elixir dependency. Unusually disciplined—deliberately avoided attacking Dynamis infrastructure to stay under the radar.
factions.history: Moved into New Rome specifically to access Mechron's bunker research. After Psyshock's death prevented full bunker access, Adam fired the Bahamut in rage.
factions.lore: Ryan respected the Meta-Gang's unusual strategic discipline. Adam the Ogre's true motive was never finding a cure; it was taking others down with him.

factions.name: President's Meta-Gang
factions.description: Ryan's version of the Meta-Gang after defeating Adam. Officially headed by 'Mr. President' (Ryan), with Sarin as VP. Guards Mechron's bunker from Dynamis.
factions.history: Formed after Ryan defeats Adam. Ryan adopts presidential persona and reorganizes the Meta remnants into a force holding Mechron's bunker against Dynamis.
factions.lore: The presidential persona is one of Ryan's most elaborate long-term jokes.

factions.name: Il Migliore
factions.description: Dynamis Corporation's official superhero team and the protectors of New Rome. Celebrity superheroes on Dynamis' payroll. They police criminal activity selectively—too afraid of the Augusti to truly disrupt them.
factions.history: Founded by Dynamis as a superhero brand. Members like Atom Cat join hoping to make a real difference, but find the organization too corporate and passive.
factions.lore: Wyvern is both the team's leader and its most genuine hero.

factions.name: Dynamis Corporation
factions.description: The megacorporation that controls New Rome and much of the Mediterranean region. Built the city from scratch after Mechron's bombing. Controls the Private Security, Il Migliore, manufacturing, media, and Knockoff Elixir production.
factions.history: Founded after the Genome Wars. Built New Rome as a corporate city-state. Maintained a Cold War-style peace with the Augusti under Hector's leadership.
factions.lore: Dynamis is described as a stabilizing force despite its systemic corruption—Shroud admits it can be reformed once Hector retires.

factions.name: The Carnival
factions.description: Leo Hargraves' wandering pro-bono superhero group. 'Real' heroes in contrast to corporate Il Migliore. Operates in individual cells for resilience. Has hunted down major threats including Mechron, Manic Plague, and Bloodstream.
factions.history: Founded by Leo Hargraves and Alice Martel (Pythia). Has fought Mechron, Manic Plague, and countless other threats. Alice's prophecy about Bloodstream guided the group for years.
factions.lore: Ryan admires the Carnival deeply—'real, pro-bono superheroes, wandering knights style'—despite them causing the worst day of his life by killing Bloodstream.

factions.name: Malleus Maleficarum
factions.description: A Catholic Church investigation division that investigates supernatural and Genome-related incidents. Has invested heavily in modern technology while maintaining Church connections across the world.
factions.history: An ancient Church institution repurposed for the modern Genome era. Currently investigating the Eva Fabre/New H vaccine-monster incidents.
factions.lore: Appears only in the final chapters' epilogue/teaser, establishing a larger conspiracy beyond New Rome's immediate conflicts.

battles_and_events.name: Delivery to Renesco / Ghoul Attack
battles_and_events.summary: Ryan's first loop. Ghoul attacks Renesco's bar and kills Ryan. After multiple loops, Ryan successfully defeats Ghoul using his Plymouth Fury as a weapon and a baseball bat, bribes Private Security, and completes the delivery.
battles_and_events.outcome: Ryan defeats Ghoul (arrested by Private Security)
battles_and_events.significance: Sets up the novel's loop mechanic and Ryan's style. First contact with New Rome's power dynamics.
lore_revealed: Meta-Gang's presence in New Rome
Augusti's bar front operations
Dynamis Private Security's corruption

battles_and_events.name: Harbor Battle (First Meta Encounter)
battles_and_events.summary: Ryan accompanies the Augusti on a supply run at the old harbor. The Meta-Gang attacks. Ryan fights Ghoul and Sarin while recognizing Len's bathysphere designs. Psyshock appears at the orphanage soon after.
battles_and_events.outcome: Meta repelled from the harbor run; Ryan discovers Len's tech is being used by the Augusti
battles_and_events.significance: First lead on Len's location in New Rome.
lore_revealed: Len has been operating in Rust Town as the Underdiver
The Augusti use Len's technology

battles_and_events.name: Defense of Rust Town Orphanage
battles_and_events.summary: Psyshock, Mosquito, and Mongrel arrive to abduct orphan children. Ryan and Atom Cat defend the orphanage. Vulcan arrives in her power armor as backup, providing Ryan his first major victory over the Meta.
battles_and_events.outcome: Children saved; Meta repelled; Ryan-Vulcan alliance formed
battles_and_events.significance: Turning point in Ryan's relationship with the Augusti (Vulcan). Psyshock identifies Ryan as 'little Cesare' and threatens Len's 'Genius brain.'
lore_revealed: Psyshock knew Ryan and Len before their Elixir days
Adam wants children for Mechron's bunker access

battles_and_events.name: Acid Rain Ambush (Ship Graveyard)
battles_and_events.summary: Psyshock follows Ryan to Shroud's garage using a DNA tracker. Deploys Acid Rain and mechanical hounds. Ryan's Plymouth Fury is destroyed. Shroud fights Psyshock while Ryan battles Acid Rain.
battles_and_events.outcome: Ryan survives; Shroud is revealed; Acid Rain temporarily defeated
battles_and_events.significance: First meeting with Shroud. Discovery that Ryan and Acid Rain's Violet powers interfere.
lore_revealed: Shroud is from the Carnival
Mechron's bunker exists under New Rome
Acid Rain and Ryan share Violet power source

battles_and_events.name: The Reunion (Len's Undersea Habitat)
